sections.content: Combine invitations with *ya* and *todavía no*, which you know from Unit 2, to talk about plans and preparations. Use *ya* for completed preparations and *todavía no* for unfinished ones. Respond to invitations by accepting, explaining what you have already done, or saying what you have not done yet.

items.english: Do you want to come to the celebration?

items.spanish: Sí, claro. Ya he preparado la comida.
items.english: Yes, of course. I have already prepared the food.

items.spanish: Todavía no he comprado la bebida.
items.english: I have not bought the drink yet.
We have already accepted the invitation.

rows: accept and say what is done
say what is not done yet

sections.content: Add *Sí, claro* first when you accept, then say what you have already done: *Sí, claro. Ya he preparado la comida.*
